scope: Static USA lifecycle and allocator evidence for the unified ASL. Not gameplay, polling, LiveSplit compilation or backend verification. The maintainer will perform gameplay testing.

source.method: Read-only Ghidra export from a disposable copy; selected resident instruction words additionally compared directly with the identified executable.
source.limits: The generic Homebrew Ghidra could not open PSX:LE:32:default; its normal process exit was not an analysis pass. The existing PSX-enabled Ghidra installation supplied the export. No original project or game data was modified.

allocator.signed_capacity: i32 payload - 0x04; negative while allocated, positive when free
allocator.ordering: Free negates signed_capacity at 0x800A42CC before coalescing physical blocks or inserting into a free list. A non-null root can therefore point to an already freed allocation.
allocator.read_guard: Check pointer/span bounds, negative capacity, required payload span excluding tail, tail marker, and bounded reciprocal physical-neighbor consistency. Combine with the object's own root, registration/class and mode/overlay context; allocator metadata alone does not identify the semantic owner.
allocator.limits: No allocation generation counter was established. Two matching asynchronous reads cannot exclude an entire free/reallocate cycle between them. Registration/owner discontinuity and read gaps must disarm event inference.

persistent_game.create: Dispatcher calls 0x8005A6B0 then sets created_flag to 1; persistent allocation is created by 0x8006993C.
persistent_game.destroy: Dispatcher calls 0x80069B8C then clears created_flag at 0x8005A37C. The destructor frees G without clearing its root.
persistent_game.limits: The created flag alone is not liveness: destruction precedes flag clearing. Gameplay mode alone is also insufficient. Use current allocation and registration/context guards before reading health or Rune quantity.

player.register: 0x80069BC0 stores A in G + 0x530 and sets byte A + 0x34 bit 0x20
player.unregister: 0x80069C10 clears G + 0x530 and that registration bit
player.active_list: Head u32 0x800EE888, sentinel 0x800EE884, node next pointer +0x04; traversal in 0x800410A4
player.limits: Check bounded list membership and allocation/class ownership rather than trusting stale registration bytes. G can remain valid on map after A unregisters.
player.private_storage: Native actor factory 0x800424F8 includes u16 definition + 0x08 private bytes immediately after the common 0x98-byte actor in the same malloc block; instructions 0x8004265C-0x80042660 store actor + 0x98 at actor + 0x90. Private pointers are bounded subspans, not independent allocations.

level_controller.initialize: 0x80040998 allocates/clears controller storage then calls descriptor + 0x40
level_controller.destroy: 0x80040B5C invokes descriptor + 0x44 then frees non-null controller storage without establishing a zeroed root
level_controller.limits: Descriptor identity establishes layout, not liveness. Reject positive/free allocator headers and wrong overlay/level context. A zero-sized descriptor has no allocated controller; initialization sets L to null.

title.constructor: TL.BIN 0x80012284 allocates and clears 0x35C bytes, stores T in the global root, then allocates 0x18 auxiliary bytes at T + 0x18C
title.limits: Allocator ownership, title overlay/mode, menu flow/selection and callback identity are separate guards; the minimum accessed offset 0x194 is not the allocation size.

gameplay_dispatch.result_3: UI class 500 handler 0x80063BB4, choice 0, writes result 3 at 0x80063C18 and requests transition through 0x8005A99C. Dispatcher tears down gameplay, frees G, clears created flag, then selects title mode 2.
gameplay_dispatch.result_6: Native death path writes result 6 at 0x80069FDC; dispatcher shares the result-3 cleanup destination. Death-substate entry precedes this later result.
gameplay_dispatch.result_5: Successful completion handling retains G and processes level progress; destination may be Hall of Heroes, another level, map or ending. It is not synonymous with a changed header or map arrival.
gameplay_dispatch.result_4: Reload or next-gameplay dispatch, not successful completion
gameplay_dispatch.transition_pending: 0x8002364C returns zero while game-flags bit 0x80 is set, so a result request can be visible before cleanup begins.
gameplay_dispatch.hoh_origin: u16 0x800EEE36 stores completed origin when next level is set to index 18; normal HoH result-5 departure restores this origin before routing.
gameplay_dispatch.limits: UI class-to-visible-Quit interpretation and asynchronous polling visibility remain untested. Never derive a manual quit from pause state or title arrival alone.

instruction_comparison.0x800A42CC: 0xACA20010: store positive freed capacity before coalescing
instruction_comparison.0x8005A37C: 0xAF8000FC: clear persistent-game created flag after destruction
